name: replit-clone
description: A cloud development platform: browser IDE, isolated execution, previews and deployments.

scripts.infra:up: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml run --rm --no-deps -T minio-init
scripts.infra:down: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile queue --profile init down --remove-orphans
scripts.infra:reset: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile queue --profile init down -v --remove-orphans
scripts.infra:logs: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml logs -f
scripts.infra:ps: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile queue --profile init ps
scripts.infra:config: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml config
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist node_modules .turbo *.tsbuildinfo && rm -rf node_modules
